generation.scope: The four half-period germs through a general Walsh point belong to exactly two global fixed-locus components, of dimensions nine and five. The three smooth five-dimensional branches have full S3 monodromy and generic stabilizer C2. The nine-dimensional component is generically free and its normalization has three nearby five-dimensional double loci. Both cuts of an order-four half-turn have symmetric rank four and alternating rank two; the alternating determinant pencils recover finite vertex frames.

open_mathematics: Parametrize the five-dimensional order-four half-period component by its two determinant pencils and symmetric extension matrices. Resolve the simultaneous Schur equations and investigate AS membership outside the Walsh locus.
